marker.identification: manual: open upward triangles (Number of lugs: 3) in panel (a); centre = area centroid of the outer triangle outline (apex plus two thirds of the height, the gnuplot convention), height 12 px

meta.source_title: Traveling performance evaluation of wheeled rover climbing various soil slopes (Sutoh, Nagatani, Yoshida; Proceedings of the 2012 JSME Conference on Robotics and Mechatronics, 1A2-L06, in Japanese)
meta.vehicle: two wheeled test rover, mass ballasted to 4.0 kg for every wheel set, axle distance 400 mm, wheel speed 2.50 rpm
meta.soil: Toyoura sand (JIS R 5200), cohesionless, nearly uniform grain size
meta.comparability_note: Panel (a), 5 mm lugs, 3 lugs = open triangle. 8 and 12 deg: triangle fully visible. 16 deg: only the base of the triangle is visible under the filled circle of 0 lugs (base 17 px wide, same as at 12 deg); centre placed one third of the height above the base. 20 deg: only the apex is visible above the filled square of 6 lugs; centre placed two thirds of the height below the apex. These two points are inferred from partial outlines. 0, 4 and 24 deg: the triangle is hidden in marker clusters and is left out. Error bars not transcribed.
